best_for: Steel analog watch with a black dial
verdict: A steel analog watch with a black dial and a 50 m water-resistance rating.
paragraphs: This is an analog watch with a black dial and a stainless steel band. The store listing gives a stainless steel case, a mineral glass cover and a 40 mm case.
The same listing mentions "his-and-hers pairs models". It also lists the occasion as formal and 50 m water resistance.
The listing gives the strap colour as silver and the band as stainless steel.
good: Stainless steel case and band, per the listing
Mineral glass cover, per the listing
50 m water-resistance rating, per the listing
not_good: In our view, this is a plain watch, since the listing names few features beyond the basics
In our view, a 40 mm case may look large on a slim wrist
The listing does not give the movement or the battery

sources.label: Casio India's authorised online store listing (casiostore.bhawar.com), MTP-1303D-1AV
Casio support notice (support.casio.in): redirects to Casio's new authorized and exclusive online store
